criterion: EvidenceClaim: supporting passage and location resolve in the cited source; population, design and endpoint transcribed correctly (protocol acceptance_criteria.evidence_claim)
Report: every number traces to a committed artifact in the same task
criterion_version: protocol v1 (A0001-StudyProtocol acceptance_criteria.evidence_claim); TaskMessage T0007 scientific_acceptance_criteria; release rel-823fa0c912cb
evaluator: R5-independent-evaluation (instance r5-src-stim, task T0007); did not produce any evaluated artifact
held_out_data: not_applicable (literature source check; no patient data or reserved outcome labels used)

result.method: R1's attached abstract snapshots and its own verification fields were NOT used. For each claim R5 re-fetched the record from Europe PMC REST (EXT_ID:<pmid> AND SRC:MED, and DOI:<doi>, resultType=core) and separately from PubMed E-utilities efetch (XML), on 2026-11-01. Bibliographic fields were compared, each supporting_passage was tested for verbatim presence (after whitespace/HTML-entity/inline-tag normalisation) in both abstracts, and the full abstracts were read to check population, design, endpoint, numbers, follow-up flag and study_family_id. For A0016 the open-access full text (PMC12457187 fullTextXML) was read to test the absence claim. For A0031 every number in the body was traced to a committed claim.
result.bibliographic_match: 15/15 (title, journal, year, volume, issue, pages, DOI, PMCID); each DOI query returned exactly the cited PMID
result.passage_resolution: 40/40 supporting_passages verbatim in Europe PMC abstract and 40/40 in PubMed abstract
result.follow_up_flags: A0002 (12-week blinded) and A0012 (3-month) correctly flagged meets_protocol_follow_up_ge_12mo=false; A0016 not_applicable; all others >=12 months as recorded
result.study_families: Grouping confirmed sensible: RNS feasibility/pivotal/LTT (A0002-A0004); SANTE RCT+LTFU (A0008-A0010); VNS E05 RCT+extension (A0012-A0013); others as separate families with overlap flagged (Englot 2011/2016 vs E05; Razavi/Sadeghzadeh/Eliashiv centre overlap to_verify)
result.A0016_full_text_finding: Full text includes 2 patients whose clinical outcomes are post-resection Engel II and Engel I (used to validate EZN estimates); no seizure outcome after model-guided therapeutic stimulation. Absence claim holds beyond the abstract.
minor_observations: A0005 and A0007: follow-up converted to months (27.6; 28.2 +/- 11.4) without the 'computed' label the claims' own reported_observation promises.
A0010: claim's SUDEP 2.0/1000 person-years is in the abstract but not quoted in supporting_passages, and it pools SANTE with prior pilot studies (not SANTE-only).
A0015: 'manufacturer registry' is not stated in the abstract.
A0031: envelope consumed_artifact_ids lists only A0001 although the body summarises A0002-A0016; process count '17 screened' not checkable from artifacts.

uncertainty_method: not_applicable (deterministic verbatim-match and manual transcription check; no statistical estimate). Residual uncertainty: abstract-level only for A0002-A0015; full-text denominators remain open under need N002.
evidence_level: abstract-level source verification against two independent indexes (Europe PMC, PubMed) for A0002-A0015; full-text verification for A0016; not a check of late-timepoint denominators or full-text tables
